infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: AttendEase uses Bluetooth to run proximity-based attendance sessions and scan nearby teacher broadcasts.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: AttendEase uses Bluetooth to run teacher attendance broadcasts during active classroom sessions.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: AttendEase uses the camera to scan QR codes for marking attendance.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AttendEase uses your location to verify you are in the classroom when marking QR attendance.
